issue_298_closure.justification: Acceptance requires a comparison contract, at least one genuinely equivalent numerical paired test, explicit missing-population accounting, and distinction from empirical validation. Level-1 includes an NSB↔nsb2 imposed-spectrum paired test through each implementation's spectral operators plus analytic checks; Level-2 remains conditional. Missing populations are not treated as zero.
